Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 1, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Write a story', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.content.inspect
```
